extrapolation.status: Eight-block sample, not a full epoch or full-history measurement

notes: R2 Standard rates; own index bucket explicitly created Standard.
Shared free allowances and bill-unit rounding apply. Tables give marginal costs, not account invoices.
One-time object upload costs are Class A; construction source reads and CPU are additional.
Complete response hits still run Worker authentication, CPU and metrics.
Per-slot resolution data are specific to one block and immutable generation; they cannot resolve all other blocks in the epoch.
Browser clients need only the chosen per-block objects. Whole-epoch pubkey tables are a different optional strategy.
The full-epoch and 1092-epoch estimates assume the eight-block mean and full slot counts; actual history differs.
Existing epoch pubkey/hash tables are not removed or duplicated by this publication.
The overhead denominator includes compressed hot blocks and signatures for the eight samples, not every existing archive sidecar.
Source-object R2 charges accrue to the Foundation bucket account. Owner payment for those charges would need reimbursement or another billing arrangement, not a second archive copy.
Observed Worker CPU is from208mixedformats/cache states; do notapplyitunchangedtoadifferenttrafficmix.

variables.Q: Total Worker HTTP requests per month
variables.K: KV key reads per month, one per request with a syntactically valid Bearer key
variables.C: Total Worker CPU milliseconds per month, from platform metrics
variables.B: Total R2 GET+HEAD operations per month across the Foundation account

notes: Included usage is shared with other services in each account. These formulas assume no other use and Standard rates.
Existing paid-account base subscription may already cover this service.
CPU quantiles do not supply average CPU per format; do not use network wall time as CPU.
Existing archive storage, KV storage/writes, log storage, provider API credits and taxes are excluded.
Analytics Engine is currently not billed; announced future point rate is additional.
